title: Strong Non-Interference for Mask-Refreshing Algorithms
summary: A refreshing-gadget construction is stated to achieve strong non-interference, but a proof for every number of shares remains open.

formal_statement.body: The mask-refreshing algorithm over $d$ shares obtained from a refreshing gadget is stated to yield a $(d-1)$-strongly non-interfering mask-refreshing algorithm, but a proof that this algorithm satisfies strong non-interference for every $d$ remains unresolved.

scope.domain: Masking schemes and strong non-interference in symmetric cryptography.
parameters: d, the number of shares in the mask-refreshing algorithm
scope.unresolved_remainder: Prove that the stated mask-refreshing algorithm satisfies strong non-interference for every d.

citations.label: Parallel Implementations of Masking Schemes and the Bounded Moment Leakage Model

progress.summary: The source states a (d-1)-strongly non-interfering guarantee for the d-share construction and explicitly leaves a proof for all d as future work.
citation_labels: Gilles Barthe et al., Parallel Implementations of Masking Schemes and the Bounded Moment Leakage Model
